CustomField.label: Absence ohne Deputy
CustomField.description: SCRUM-457 AC8 + AC10: "OHNE DEPUTY" while an absence is running today or starts within the next 14 days AND (no deputy named OR the named deputy's own absence window covers today) — a deputy who is away themselves is no deputy, so those customers stand out exactly like the ones without a deputy. Same marker value on both causes; blank otherwise. Formula field, read-only.
CustomField.formula: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_Start__c)) && NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_End__c)) && Absence_End__c >= TODAY() && Absence_Start__c - TODAY() <= 14 && (ISBLANK(Absence_Deputy__c) || (NOT(ISBLANK(Absence_Deputy_End__c)) && Absence_Deputy_Start__c <= TODAY() && Absence_Deputy_End__c >= TODAY())), "OHNE DEPUTY", "")
